name: Argentiferous-Playa
description: Heat is the local god. Fissures glow along every fault line, the air tastes of sulfur past exposed planetary core, and by dark the ground itself still glows faintly, like a banked furnace.

The air carries wet iron and lichen, and sound behaves strangely: footsteps crack loud, then die without echo. At night the temperature drops fast enough to hear the rock tick as it contracts. Mats of pigment-bearing microbes stain the wet stone in bands of rust and violet.
Something about this world resists explanation. Every expedition answers three questions and returns with five better ones.
Whoever controls uranium controls the approach lanes. Three factions have done the arithmetic, and only two of them are being subtle about it.
